_meta.basis: Supply and lay rates including subgrade preparation, base, joints and finishing. Quantities come from src/commercial/catalogue/pavements/logic.js. Indicative only, check with a quantity surveyor.

status_legend.VERIFIED_SECONDARY: A published figure read from a council schedule, agency page or industry article, to be checked against the source
status_legend.ESTIMATE: Analyst estimate with the reasoning in `basis`, no direct public source

_meta.statusNote: Every rate here has status ESTIMATE: public figures were found only for a few items and are residential or city based, so they are anchors and not the rate. Anchors are listed under sources with their own status.

concrete-heavy.basis: 200 mm N40 reinforced slab with dowelled joints on 150 mm lean mix subbase and select fill. Scaled up from published reinforced slab figures (thin residential slabs) for thickness, double mesh, base and regional access. Analyst estimate.

sources.publisher: Yellow Pages Australia, how much does a concrete slab cost
sources.figure: Reinforced concrete slab $65 to $90 per m2, exposed aggregate or decorative $100 to $170 per m2, heavy duty slabs 150 to 200 mm and reinforced

concrete-light.basis: 125 mm N32 reinforced slab on 150 mm crushed rock. Published reinforced slab range $65 to $90 per m2 is for light residential slabs, uplifted for commercial base preparation and joints.

sources.publisher: Yellow Pages Australia, how much does a concrete slab cost
sources.figure: Reinforced concrete slab $65 to $90 per m2, exposed aggregate or decorative $100 to $170 per m2, heavy duty slabs 150 to 200 mm and reinforced

asphalt-ac10-car.basis: 40 mm AC10 on 150 mm DGB20 and 150 mm DGS40 including subgrade preparation and tack coat. Published $35 to $70 per m2 is for thin driveway overlays on minimal base, commercial make-up costs more.

sources.publisher: Airtasker Oneflare cost guide, asphalt driveway
sources.figure: Asphalt supply and lay $35 to $45 per m2 standard, state ranges $35 to $70 per m2, Sydney highest, premium finishes to $100 to $175 per m2

asphalt-ac14-car.basis: 40 mm AC14 on the same base as AC10 car, small premium for the coarser mix. Analyst estimate.

sources.publisher: Airtasker Oneflare cost guide, asphalt driveway
sources.figure: Asphalt supply and lay $35 to $45 per m2 standard, state ranges $35 to $70 per m2, Sydney highest, premium finishes to $100 to $175 per m2

asphalt-ac10-truck.basis: 30 mm AC10 over 50 mm AC14 on 200 mm DGB20 and 250 mm DGS40. Analyst estimate from asphalt tonnage and base volumes.

sources.publisher: Airtasker Oneflare cost guide, asphalt driveway
sources.figure: Asphalt supply and lay $35 to $45 per m2 standard, state ranges $35 to $70 per m2, Sydney highest, premium finishes to $100 to $175 per m2

asphalt-ac14-truck.basis: 50 mm AC14 over 60 mm AC20 on 200 mm DGB20 and 250 mm DGS40. Analyst estimate from asphalt tonnage and base volumes.

sources.publisher: Airtasker Oneflare cost guide, asphalt driveway
sources.figure: Asphalt supply and lay $35 to $45 per m2 standard, state ranges $35 to $70 per m2, Sydney highest, premium finishes to $100 to $175 per m2

spray-seal.basis: Two coat spray seal on 200 mm DGB20 and 150 mm DGS40. No public regional schedule found. Analyst estimate.

gravel-yard.basis: 100 mm crushed rock wearing course on 200 mm DGB20, compacted and graded. No public regional schedule found. Analyst estimate.

permeable-pavers.basis: 80 mm permeable interlocking pavers on 30 mm bedding, 100 mm open graded base and 250 mm reservoir subbase with geotextile. Analyst estimate, open graded stone is a large part of the cost.

concrete-footpath.basis: 100 mm N25 SL72 broom finish footpath on 75 mm bedding. Published residential path and driveway figures are $65 to $150 per m2.

sources.figure: Exposed aggregate $100 to $150 per m2, driveway $65 to $150 per m2

sources.publisher: Yellow Pages Australia, how much does a concrete slab cost
sources.figure: Reinforced concrete slab $65 to $90 per m2, exposed aggregate or decorative $100 to $170 per m2, heavy duty slabs 150 to 200 mm and reinforced

unit-pavers-ped.basis: 60 mm concrete unit pavers on sand bedding and 100 mm crushed rock base. Analyst estimate.

exposed-aggregate.basis: 100 mm exposed aggregate concrete on 100 mm base. Published exposed aggregate range is $100 to $170 per m2 (May 2026) and $100 to $150 per m2 (2023).

sources.publisher: Yellow Pages Australia, how much does a concrete slab cost
sources.figure: Reinforced concrete slab $65 to $90 per m2, exposed aggregate or decorative $100 to $170 per m2, heavy duty slabs 150 to 200 mm and reinforced
Exposed aggregate $100 to $150 per m2, driveway $65 to $150 per m2

barrier-kg.basis: Barrier kerb and gutter. Anchor: Lake Macquarie City Council 2023-24 charge of $150 per metre for commercial and industrial frontages, escalated about 10 percent to late 2026. Councils set their own rates.

sources.publisher: Lake Macquarie City Council kerb and channel fact sheet 2023-24 (Fees and Charges 2023-24)
sources.figure: Kerb and channel $127 per metre of frontage residential and rural, $150 per metre commercial and industrial frontages

layback-kg.basis: Layback (roll top) kerb and gutter, priced about 3 percent below barrier kerb and gutter (less formwork). Same anchor as barrier kerb and gutter.

sources.publisher: Lake Macquarie City Council kerb and channel fact sheet 2023-24 (Fees and Charges 2023-24)
sources.figure: Kerb and channel $127 per metre of frontage residential and rural, $150 per metre commercial and industrial frontages

mountable.basis: Mountable kerb, extruded or formed in place. Analyst estimate.

flush-edge.basis: Flush concrete edge strip 300 mm wide. Analyst estimate.

kerb-only-b.basis: Kerb only, extruded or formed in place, no gutter. Analyst estimate.

dish-drain.basis: Concrete dish drain 600 mm wide, formed in place. Analyst estimate.

bay-lines.basis: Two side lines per bay, 100 mm, painted. Analyst estimate.

accessible-symbol.basis: Blue square with white symbol, stencilled. Analyst estimate.

accessible-hatch.basis: Shared zone hatch, painted. Analyst estimate.

ped-crossing.basis: Painted crossing of about 6 stripes. Analyst estimate.

give-way.basis: Painted give way line. Analyst estimate.

wheel-stop.basis: Precast concrete wheel stop, supplied and fixed with dowels. Analyst estimate.

speed-hump.basis: Low profile asphalt or rubber speed hump, supplied and fixed. Analyst estimate.

loading-zone-hatch.basis: Painted hatched zone of about 18 m2. Analyst estimate.

keep-clear.basis: Painted keep clear box. Analyst estimate.

drainage-detention.basis: Stormwater pits and pipes, small on-site detention, kerb inlets and lintels, per m2 of hardstand. No public source. Calibrated so that the full site works build up (pavements, kerbs, markings and both allowances) lands inside the existing flat range of $120 to $250 per m2 of developed area in market.json.

pad-services.basis: Building pad preparation, trenching and service connections (water, sewer, power, communications) per m2 of building footprint. No public source. Same calibration as the drainage and detention allowance.
